title: Paramasivan
desc: A man waits to meet his fate after being sentenced to death for killing six policemen. However, an officer asks him to help catch a terrorist group.

title: Pethi Sollai Thattathe
desc: A young man, returning home from higher studies, falls in love with a girl whom he meets on the train. Later, they get married and face multiple challenges.

title: Chithiram Pesuthadi
desc: Thiru, a local gangster, changes his wayward ways after falling in love with an NGO worker. However, his path toward redemption is jeopardised after the police arrest him for his past crimes.

title: Kalloori Vaasal
desc: Sathya and Vasanth are two best friends since their childhood. However, when Sathya and Pooja get engaged, he learns about a terrible truth that threatens to break his friendship with Vasanth.

title: Autograph
desc: Senthil, an advertising executive, decides to invite his old friends to his wedding. His past is unraveled as he sets out on a journey to meet his old friends and lovers.
